welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: A trusted network for thalassemia patients and blood donors.

auth.forgotPasswordBody: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
auth.resetLinkSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.
auth.noAccount: Don't have an account? Sign up
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

verifyEmail.title: Check your email
verifyEmail.body: We've sent a confirmation link to your email. Confirm it, then come back and sign in.

onboarding.title: Tell us about you
onboarding.rolesLabel: I am a... (choose all that apply)
onboarding.shareContactLabel: Share my phone number after a donor accepts
onboarding.shareContactHint: If off, contact stays in-app only. You can change this anytime in settings.

donorProfile.title: Donor settings
donorProfile.eligibilityDisclaimer: Eligibility to donate is decided by the blood bank or a doctor.
donorProfile.donationHistoryEmptyDescription: Confirmed donations will show up here.
donorProfile.emergencyAvailableHint: If on, families outside your network in your district can ask you to help in an emergency. They see your name only; your phone number is shown only if you accept and have chosen to share it.
donorProfile.searchable: Let families find me in donor search
donorProfile.searchableHint: If on, a family whose request still needs donors can see your name, area and how recently you were active, and invite you. Your phone number is never shown in search.
donorProfile.nearbyHint: If you share an approximate location, families whose request is at a nearby verified centre can find you. Only a rounded area (about 1 km) is saved, and families see only a distance range, never your location.
donorProfile.locationDenied: Location permission was not given, so nothing was shared.
donorProfile.remindersHint: A gentle reminder to update your availability some time after your last recorded donation, or when your "available from" date arrives. It never means you can donate; only a doctor or blood bank can say that.

patients.thalassemiaTypeHint: Voluntary. Only shown to donors if you turn that on below.
patients.visibilityHint: Strangers never see any of this — only donors you've connected with, and only what you allow here.
patients.emptyDescription: Add a patient to start building their donor network.
patients.joinAsGuardian: Join as guardian with a code

network.invalidCode: Enter the 8-character code exactly as given.
network.requestSent: Request sent. The family will review it.
network.shareMessage: Join {{name}}'s donor network on Thalassemia Support. Invite code: {{code}}
network.limitHint: You can connect up to {{max}} donors per patient.
network.emptyDescription: Share your patient's invite code, or enter one from a donor's invite.
network.removeConfirmBody: They'll no longer see this patient. This can't be undone, but they can be invited again later.
network.leaveConfirmBody: You'll no longer see this patient's requests. This can't be undone, but you can rejoin with a new invite later.
network.familyAsked: This family asked you to join their donor network. You can say no; nobody else is told.

requests.title: Blood requests
requests.cancelConfirmBody: Donors who haven't responded yet will no longer see it. This can't be undone.
requests.emptyDescription: Create a request when a patient needs blood.
requests.componentHint: As advised by the hospital. The app doesn't decide this.
requests.donorReportedDonated: The donor says they've donated — awaiting your confirmation.
requests.confirmDonationBody: This records that the donation happened and cannot be undone. Only confirm once the donation is actually complete.
requests.withdrawConfirmBody: The family will be notified. There's no penalty for withdrawing.
requests.iDonatedConfirmTitle: Let the family know you donated?
requests.iDonatedConfirmBody: This tells the family you believe you've donated. It is not the final record — they still need to confirm it before it counts as a completed donation.
requests.acceptedNote: You've said you can donate. This isn't a completed donation yet — the family confirms that once it happens.
requests.completedNote: Thank you — this donation has been confirmed.

inbox.emptyDescription: You'll see blood requests here when a connected patient needs your blood group.

wizard.title: Request blood
wizard.disclaimer: This app does not decide how much blood is needed or who is eligible to donate — that's for the hospital and blood bank to advise.

tierHint.regular: If not enough regular donors can help, backup donors are asked automatically.
tierHint.backup: Still not enough donors? You can search for more donors in your district.
tierHint.broad: You can search for donors outside your network.

search.title: Find donors
search.resultsHint: Only donors who chose to appear in search. Contact details are never shown here.
search.askToJoinBody: If they accept, they join as a backup donor. You can change this later.
search.emptyDescription: Try including the whole division, or check again later.
search.nearbyHint: Distance from the request's verified centre to donors who chose to share an approximate location.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyDescription: You'll see updates about your connections and requests here.
notifications.pushUnsupportedInExpoGo: Push notifications aren't available in Expo Go on Android. Install a development build to receive them, or check this list in-app.

messages.request_escalated: Not enough donors yet: backup donors have been asked
messages.guardian_removed: You were removed as a guardian
messages.community_comment_added: Someone commented on your community post
messages.community_content_moderated: A moderator reviewed your community content
messages.community_content_auto_hidden: Community content was hidden after reports and needs review
messages.community_report_urgent: Community content was reported for selling blood
messages.organization_reverification_due: An organization in the directory is due for re-verification
messages.organization_marked_stale: An organization was hidden because its verification is overdue
messages.content_review_due: Published awareness content is due for re-review
messages.organization_member_added: You were added as staff of an organization
messages.availability_check_in: Time for a check-in: update your availability if it has changed. Only a doctor or blood bank can say whether you can donate.
messages.transfusion_upcoming: A patient's next transfusion date is coming up. Create a blood request if you need donors.

notificationPreferences.title: Notification preferences
notificationPreferences.inAppAlwaysOnHint: In-app notifications are always on. Choose which ones also send a push notification.

disclaimer.generic: This app does not decide donor eligibility, blood quantity, compatibility, or medical treatment. Always consult a doctor or blood bank for those decisions.

errors.post_limit_reached: You've reached today's posting limit. Please try again tomorrow.

errors.cannot_remove_own_admin: You can't remove your own admin role.

errors.review_required: This content needs a human review before publishing.
errors.source_required: Link at least one source before publishing.
errors.source_not_checked: Every linked source must be checked by a person before publishing.
errors.invalid_source: Please check the source title and link.

errors.invalid_content: Please fill in the title and text in both languages.
errors.invalid_donation_date: The donation date can't be in the future or before the request was made.

emergency.stepTitle: Before you publish an emergency request
emergency.noticeTitle: This app is not an emergency service
emergency.noticeBody: If a life is in danger, call {{number}} or go to the nearest hospital now. This request only notifies donors; it does not arrange blood or medical care.
emergency.acknowledge: I understand this app is not an emergency service
emergency.notifyNearby: Also notify nearby donors who accept emergency requests
emergency.notifyNearbyHint: Donors in the same district who chose to help in emergencies. They see the request details, but not the patient's name.

history.emptyDescription: Donations you confirm will appear here.
history.thanksHint: The donor sees only this message, not your name. Please don't include money or offers.

guardians.title: Guardians
guardians.hint: Guardians can create blood requests, manage donors and confirm donations for this patient.
guardians.inviteHint: Share this code with a family member. It works once and expires on {{date}}.
guardians.shareMessage: Use code {{code}} in the Thalassemia Support app (Patients → Join as guardian) to help manage {{name}}.
guardians.removeConfirmBody: {{name}} will no longer see or manage this patient.
guardians.leaveConfirmBody: You will no longer see or manage this patient.
guardians.joinHint: Enter the 8-character code a guardian shared with you.

account.exportHint: A copy of the information this app keeps about you.
account.deleteHint: Removes your personal details, ends your donor connections and signs you out. Past donations stay in patients' records as "Deleted user".
account.deleteConfirmBody: This can't be undone. Open requests you manage alone will be cancelled and your donor connections ended.

community.title: Community
community.banner: Posts are personal experiences from patients and families. They are not medical advice. Always follow your doctor or treatment centre.
community.feedEmptyDescription: Be the first to share an experience or ask a question.
community.composerWarning: Share your own experience. Don't give medicine names with doses, diagnoses or treatment instructions, and never ask for or offer money for blood.
community.hiddenNotice: Hidden while a moderator reviews it. Only you can see it.
community.deletePostDescription: The post and its comments will no longer be shown.
community.deleteCommentDescription: The comment will no longer be shown.
community.blockDescription: You won't see each other's posts or comments, and neither of you can send a connection request to the other. They won't be told.
community.reportIntro: Why are you reporting this? A moderator will review it. The author won't see who reported it.

reasons.selling_blood: Buying or selling blood / asking for money

community.reportThanks: Thank you. A moderator will review it.
community.guidelinesIntro: This community is for sharing personal experiences and support. Please read and accept these rules before posting.

guidelines.personal: Share your own experience. Everything here is personal experience, not medical advice.
guidelines.noMedicalAdvice: Don't tell others which medicine or dose to take, or whether someone can donate. Those decisions belong to doctors and blood banks.
guidelines.noMoney: No buying or selling blood, and no requests for money. Blood donation here is voluntary.
guidelines.privacy: Protect privacy: don't post phone numbers, addresses, reports or photos of other people.
guidelines.respect: Be kind and respectful. No harassment, hate or shaming.
guidelines.report: Report posts that break these rules. Reported posts may be hidden until a moderator reviews them.
guidelines.emergency: This is not an emergency service. In an emergency, contact your hospital or call 999.

directory.title: Verified directory
directory.disclaimer: Only entries checked by our team are listed, with the date they were last verified. Details can change: please call before you visit. A listing is not a recommendation.
directory.detailDisclaimer: Please confirm services, hours and blood availability directly with the organization. This app does not arrange treatment or blood.
directory.emptyDescription: Entries appear here after our team has verified them.
directory.pickHint: Link this verified entry to the patient. New blood requests will use it; the treating centre text stays as it is.
directory.patientCentreHint: Link a verified centre from the directory. If yours isn't listed, the treating centre text below is enough.

admin.title: Admin
admin.roleConfirm: Change roles for {{name}}? This is recorded in the audit log.
admin.settingsHint: Product rules, not medical rules. Values are whole numbers from 1 to 10000. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
admin.organizationsHint: Add only real organizations you have checked. Users see an entry only after it is verified.
admin.newOrganizationHint: Save the details first, then record how you verified them.

orgFieldErrors.name: Enter a name (up to 200 characters).
orgFieldErrors.latitude: Enter a number from -90 to 90, together with longitude.
orgFieldErrors.longitude: Enter a number from -180 to 180, together with latitude.

admin.verificationHint: Check the details yourself (e.g. call the organization or check its official website) before marking it verified. Verified entries must be re-checked every year.
admin.contentRules: Medical content is published only after a human review with checked sources (docs/CONTENT_SAFETY.md). No diagnosis, eligibility, dosage or fear messaging, and never tell anyone whom to marry.
admin.reviewHint: Approve only after you have read the text in both languages against its sources and the content safety checklist. Your name is recorded as the reviewer.
admin.sourcesHint: Link at least one source. Content can only be published when every linked source has been checked by a person.
admin.contentLockedHint: Published and retired content can't be edited. Retire it and move it back to draft to make changes.
admin.editResetsReview: Saving changes moves this item back to draft; it needs a new review.
admin.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.
admin.sourcesPageHint: Tick "checked today" only after you have opened the source and confirmed it supports the content that cites it.
admin.sourceCheckedToday: I opened and checked this source (dated today)

learn.title: Learn
learn.disclaimer: General information only, not medical advice, diagnosis or a genetic risk assessment. Talk to a doctor or genetic counsellor about your own situation.
learn.medicineDisclaimer: Information only. This app never tells you to start, stop or change a medicine or its dose. Follow your doctor's advice.
learn.journeySubtitle: A short step-by-step guide. No quiz, nothing is saved.
learn.simulatorSubtitle: A fixed educational diagram. It asks nothing about you.
learn.emptyDescription: Articles appear here after a qualified reviewer has checked them against trusted sources.
learn.simulatorBanner: Educational example — not a personal medical/genetic risk assessment
learn.simulatorKey: Everyone has two copies of the gene. "A" is a typical copy and "a" is a changed copy. A child gets one copy from each parent, so each box shows one possible combination.
learn.simulatorNote: The boxes show possible combinations, not what will happen in a real family, and real situations can differ by type of thalassemia. Ask a doctor or genetic counsellor about your own situation.
learn.stepComingSoon: The article for this step is still being reviewed. Please check back later.
learn.journeyEndBody: Whether screening is right for you or your family, and what results mean, is best discussed with a doctor or genetic counsellor. The decisions are yours.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.intro: Totals and rates only. No person or request can be looked up here.
analytics.medianResponse: Median time to first "I can donate"
analytics.privacyNote: To protect privacy, counts from 1 to {{count}} minus one are shown as "fewer than {{count}}", and rates need at least {{count}} requests. Current patient, donor and network counts ignore the period.

orgPortal.title: Organization portal
orgPortal.intro: You see only blood requests that families have linked to your organization, with the minimum needed to confirm donations. Please keep this information confidential.
orgPortal.noOrganizations: You are not staff of any organization
orgPortal.noOrganizationsHint: An admin adds staff after verifying the organization.
orgPortal.requestsHint: Open requests, and requests fulfilled in the last 30 days.
orgPortal.confirmHint: Confirm a donation only after it has happened at your organization. It is recorded as organization-verified, and the family and donor are notified.
orgPortal.noResponses: No donor has said they can donate yet.
orgPortal.confirmBody: You confirm this donor donated on {{date}} at your organization. This can't be undone.
orgPortal.staffHint: Staff can see requests linked to this organization and confirm donations. Adding someone gives them the Organization role.
